items.informal_name: Free iff Torsion-Free for Finitely Generated Modules over PIDs

  [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R] [Module.Finite R M], Module.Free R M ↔ Module.IsTorsionFree R M
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a principal ideal domain and $ M $ a finitely generated $ R $-module. Then $ M $ is free if and only if it is torsion-free.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R] {S : Type u_4} [inst_3 : CommRing S]
  [inst_4 : Algebra R S] {I : Ideal S} [hI₁ : Module.Finite R ↥I] [hI₂ : Module.IsTorsionFree R ↥I], Module.Free R ↥I
items.informal_description: Every finitely generated torsion-free module over a principal ideal domain is free. Specifically, if $ R $ is a commutative ring that is a principal ideal ring, and $ I $ is an ideal of an $ R $-algebra $ S $ that is finitely generated as an $ R $-module and torsion-free, then $ I $ admits a basis as an $ R $-module.

items.informal_name: Basis for Finitely Generated Torsion-Free Modules over a PID
items.type:
{R : Type u_2} →
  [inst : CommRing R] →
    {M : Type u_3} →
      [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] →
        [inst_2 : Module R M] →
          [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] →
            [IsDomain R] → [Module.Finite R M] → [Module.IsTorsionFree R M] → (n : ℕ) × Module.Basis (Fin n) R M
items.informal_description: Given a finitely generated torsion-free module $ M $ over a principal ideal domain (PID) $ R $, there exists a natural number $ n $ and an $ R $-module basis for $ M $ indexed by $ \mathrm{Fin}(n) $, proving that $ M $ is a free module of finite rank.
